objective: Implement and dogfood the minimum Continuity path that resumes a Claude Code-oriented Run from a verified repository-local Checkpoint without transcript reconstruction or duplicate effects.
constraints: No broad migration of the current Nestfolio runtime.
No external writes, hosted control plane, multi-executor parity, or automatic Lesson promotion.
expected_outputs: completed Work and Working Set state
shared_completion_boundary: All deterministic criteria pass, each has Evidence, the Run completes revision-safely, and no Lesson is promoted.

exclusions: Existing Nestfolio business applications, services, infrastructure, and domain code.
Current runtime feature families outside the minimum concepts reused by VS-001.
Parallel fan-out, Epic orchestration, deploy/release, hosted collaboration, RBAC, analytics, and universal Console.

completion_criteria.description: The bounded Core/store/Pack behavior passes deterministic unit tests.
The material dogfood file effect exists with the expected content.

validator.contains: VS-001 keyed effect completed exactly once.

completion_criteria.description: Canonical artifacts prove two Sessions, a verified Checkpoint, a published Handoff, a passing resume check, and one completed keyed effect.
A candidate Lesson and an unsafe rejected Lesson exist, and neither changed a Skill or Guard automatically.

required_evidence: test result for each deterministic command criterion
repository-file Evidence for the keyed effect
learning governance Evidence proving no promotion
